Website terms

Terms for using this website

Effective 1 November 2026. These terms apply to the public website and do not replace a signed project agreement.

Information purpose

The website provides general information about Sankofa Digital ZA, its services, process and selected product work. It is not professional legal, medical, financial or emergency advice.

Project engagements

An enquiry does not create a client relationship, reserve delivery capacity or commit either party to a price, date or scope. Any project begins only under an agreed written proposal, statement of work or other contract.

Portfolio descriptions

Portfolio entries describe the intended product purpose and public-safe implementation evidence available at the time of publication. Status labels identify controlled pilots, internal platforms, MVPs and evaluation products. No entry should be read as a guarantee of a result for another organisation.

Intellectual property

The Sankofa Digital ZA name, website design, original copy, artwork and product materials are protected by applicable intellectual-property rights. Client and partner names, brands and materials remain the property of their respective owners. Website content may not be copied or republished for commercial use without written permission.

External services

Email, telephone and WhatsApp links connect to services outside this website. Sankofa Digital ZA does not control their availability, security or terms.

Availability and accuracy

Reasonable care is taken to keep the website accurate and available. Information may change, and temporary interruption or error is possible. Contact the studio if a material claim needs confirmation for a procurement or project decision.

Contact

Questions about these terms can be sent to sankofa.digital.studios@gmail.com.
